notes: GODSToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named GODS OF IMD (GODS) with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 GODS once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. Transfers deliver the full amount without fees or burns. There are no administrative powers, external mint functions or application contracts. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
